item.text: The view currently renders one tile per result, while each result already exposes its full context timeline and direct match index. I’m changing the tile to accept an explicit merged timeline and match indices, and the view to accumulate adjacent overlaps in the same reverse iteration used for chronological display.

The first implementation is in place, including event-specific highlight links derived from each matched event’s own ID. The focused Jest run is taking longer than expected; once it finishes I’ll address any failures and check the TypeScript/lint surface for these files.

item.text:
Implemented greedy merging of adjacent search results when their timelines share the boundary event. Merged tiles render the full timeline, highlight only direct matches, and link each match to its own event ID. Updated the existing tile test fixture and checkpoint.

Verification passed: focused Jest suites (2 suites, 8 tests), TypeScript, Prettier, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.
